title: My Godot platformer, looking for feedback on gameplay readability
author: Igafann
selftext:
Hi everyone! Here’s a short gameplay clip from Adventure of Milo, a project I’m building in Godot with AI assistance for coding and visual assets.

It’s still a work in progress, and I’m learning along the way. I’d appreciate specific feedback: is the character easy to follow, are the platforms clear, and do the movement and combat look readable ?

comments.author: Redditry199
comments.body: This isn't AI assistance this is a ripoff. Congrats, Claude reverse engineered hollow knight.

replies.author: Igafann
replies.body: Hollow Knight is absolutely an inspiration, and I’m open about that. But saying I simply asked Claude to copy it doesn’t reflect how I’m making this game. I’m happy to discuss specific similarities and hear constructive criticism, but please don’t assume my entire process from a short clip.

replies.author: Igafann
replies.body:
Nothing in this game was taken from Hollow Knight. The art assets were generated with Imagen and the code was written with Claude, inside my own Godot project. Nothing was ripped, decompiled or reverse engineered.

Yes, Hollow Knight is a huge inspiration, and I’ve never hidden that. I studied how it builds atmosphere and paces its rooms, the way any dev studies the games they love. Studying a game isn’t stealing from it, and I reject the idea that this is theft.

If you think a specific asset or mechanic was copied, point to it and I’ll gladly show how it was made.

replies.author: AsparagusOk8818
replies.body:
Okay. So. 

Try to take a step back and just look at your project. Yes, you did not decompile anything or directly rip anything from Hollow Knight. 

Look at it. Just... look at it. 

The only thing different here is the character, and frankly they seem out of place. She is underground because... well, because that's the environment in Hollow Knight. There's bioluminescence and fungus and you're fighting bugs because... that's Hollow Knight. But your character isn't a bug, she's some kind of humanoid demon. Why is she in this environment? 

...Because Hollow Knight. Yeah? 

You say it is inspiration, but this is just replication. I get no sense of who your character is, what your world is like, or anything. Because it's just Hollow Knight but with a reskinned main character. 

  
The inspiration isn't the problem. It just looks like you don't have an actual vision for a game beyond imitating a different game that you love.

replies.author: Redditry199
replies.body: This is not 'inspiration', the animation frame length and duration, effects, lighting, the way enemies react to attack even the freaking fireflies. I don't know who you're trying to bullshit bro. At this point it's even sadder if Claude reverse engineered it without you even knowing because dear god that is just hilarious to think about.

comments.author: StandardCategory5153
comments.body:
Cool.   
  
IMO it's fine because no one will buy this. It's too much of a clone. But if you're doing it for your own enjoyment or to learn game its fine. 

There's no reason for anyone seeing this to get upset, because you won't make a dime of it or impact Silk Song's sales.

replies.author: Igafann
replies.body: Cool it's just a personal project. Not on steam and won't be

replies.author: StandardCategory5153
replies.body: Ya. I mean it also doesn't matter even if you DO put it on Steam, because it won't make money. You'd just lose your $100 steam requires.

comments.author: beta_1457
comments.body:
It's currently way too similar to Hollow Knight. It's obviously inspired by if not directly copying Hollow Knight. Hollow Knight isn't necessarily very original in it's gameplay. It's a platformer. There are thousands of them.

The thing that makes Hollow Knight stand out is it's visuals. Your current visuals are incredibly similar but not as good as their hand drawn assets. The color is jarring with the high contrast.

If you're going to stick with this style you need to think of ways to make it more original in style, theming, and/or gameplay. Right now you have a Hollow Knight clone. A general person has no real reason to try your product over a proven high quality product.

None of this criticism is directly related to your AI use. You have a creative direction and art direction issue. What makes your product better or different than the one you are copying?

replies.author: Igafann
replies.body: Wait, are you comparing my project to Hollow Knight? Thanks!

replies.author: beta_1457
replies.body: Yes. It's a platformer with a visual style clearly based on hollow Knight down to the UI... Are you surprised?

comments.author: Igafann
comments.body:
I don’t think I’ve managed to capture its atmosphere, and I wouldn’t dream of putting my work on Team Cherry’s level.

I actually made a separate test room with a completely different visual approach that felt much closer to Hollow Knight, but I removed it from the project.

I understand why people see the resemblance. What I disagree with is the assumption that I just asked Claude to copy the game and called it a day. I’m learning, experimenting, and putting a lot of work into this. Specific feedback is welcome, but a short clip doesn’t tell the whole story.
